execution: Manual local invocation by the project owner; preparing this runner does not launch inference.
condition_order: unconstrained then constrained within each model; timing is descriptive, not a decoder-speed comparison

statistics.decoder_effect: constrained minus unconstrained within each model
statistics.interaction: (model_b minus model_a) constrained minus (model_b minus model_a) unconstrained
statistics.interpretation: Exploratory paired subject-cluster percentile intervals; unadjusted, not simultaneous confidence bounds or confirmatory multiplicity-controlled tests. Rankings and sign reversals are descriptive.
statistics.secondary: Whole-output Markdown-fence normalization only; unchanged native labels and hierarchy checks. No JSON extraction, label repair or retries based on correctness.

prior_exposure: Original E3 outputs and synthetic contract-comparison results have already been inspected; this is a prospective paired follow-up on an existing dataset, not untouched external validation.
claim_boundary: Contract sensitivity on a second, candidate-conditioned clinical-note task; not identical-criterion synthetic-to-EHR transfer, compact-versus-full replication, clinical benefit or measured performance at scale.

release_provenance.portable_binding: Primary config hash binds to the portable release. The retained dataset manifest hash identifies the paper run; verify and rebind to a newly generated local manifest before a new run. Do not edit or relabel existing outputs.
